spans.s: इल tad. affix applied to the words काश, अश्वत्थ, पलाश and others in the four senses prescribed in
इलच् (I) tad. affix इल (इलच्) in the sense of pity; e. g. देवियः, यज्ञिलः cf.

. The tad.affix घन् is also affixed in the same sense. See ईय. (2) tad. affix इल (इलच्) in the sense of possession, prescribed after the words फेन, लोमन् कपि, सिकता, शर्करा, तुन्द, उदर, घट, यव etc.; e.g. फेनिल, लोमिल, कपिल, सिकतिल तुन्दिल etc. cf.
